title: input_enqueue : crash when switching to nvim and pressing a key

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

milestone.title: backlog
milestone.description: Low priority items. We plan to work on this but don't have a target date.

body:
<!-- Before reporting: search existing issues and check the FAQ. -->

- `nvim --version`: v0.4.3
- `vim -u DEFAULTS` (version: ) behaves differently? I don't know
- Operating system/version: Arch Linux
- Front-end: [neovim-gtk](https://github.com/daa84/neovim-gtk) v0.2.0-67-g0af8952

Sometimes (rarely, maybe once every 2 days) neovim crashes after switching back to nvim-gtk (as in, I was working on another workspace with another window and went back to nvim-gtk) and pressing some key. I usually have a horizontal split with a text buffer on the left, and a terminal buffer as well as a preview window in a vertical split on the right.
